description: This file defines the class ActivityTransitionDetails, which is an Android Activity responsible for displaying an image and handling a transition animation to another activity (ActivityTransition). It manages image resources, retrieves data from intent extras, and initiates scene transition animations.

classes.name: ActivityTransitionDetails
classes.description: An Android activity that displays an image with a transition animation to another activity, dynamically changes background color, and manages image resources based on intent extras.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets background color, inflates layout, and sets the image drawable.

methods.name: getHeroDrawable
methods.description: Retrieves the drawable resource based on intent extra, updates internal state.

methods.name: clicked
methods.description: Handles click event to launch the next activity with a scene transition animation.

methods.name: randomColor
methods.description: Generates a random dark color used for background.
